usageBudget.title: AI usage budget

usageBudget.sharesDescription: Set each theme's share (%) manually. The total must be 100% or less.
usageBudget.shareTotalTooHigh: Shares add up to more than 100%
usageBudget.suggestionTitle: Suggestion from the last 30 days (not saved)
usageBudget.noSuggestion: No usage in the last 30 days, so no suggestion

usageBudget.ruleInvalid: Enter a keyword and a target theme
